name: Remove SDH Annotations
focusedTests: isolated x86_64 and universal exclusive-mode application
acceptance: Unpatched NuvioTV has no Morphe entry
Patched NuvioTV shows Settings → Morphe → Subtitles
Subtitles expands in the existing pane and shows one native SDH subtitle processing selector with its current value
The selector opens the same native choice-modal layout, focus treatment, typography, spacing, selected fill, checkmark, and D-pad order as Nuvio's Playback selector
Exactly one of Off, Normalize music symbols only, Remove SDH, keep lyrics, and Full cleanup is selected in the modal
A fresh installation defaults to Normalize music symbols only, while every stored mode persists after force-stop and reboot
Off preserves the full subtitle text and source identity
Normalize music symbols only replaces supported mojibake and boundary tokens inferred after three total or two consecutive case-insensitive occurrences without removing text
Remove SDH, keep lyrics removes complete single-line and multiline annotations while preserving likely lyrics with normalized markers
Full cleanup also removes all text enclosed by normal, supported mojibake, or evidence-inferred music-note markers
No crash, ANR, VerifyError, or fatal log during launch, settings, playback, seeking, or track changes
